description: A dark yard piled high with discarded metal, old boots, and rusted cans. Sparks occasionally fly from exposed wires. A dangerous Cutlery Monster stalker is lurking here!

exit_west.description: A heavy metal door leading back to the Noodle Factory.

scrap_wall.description: Unstable mountains of compressed scrap metal that loom overhead.

scrapyard_floor.description: Oil-stained ground littered with sharp metal shavings.

rubber_scrap.description: A pile of discarded gaskets, hoses, and shredded tires. It's spongy underfoot.

item.name: Rubber Piece
item.opened_description: A pile of discarded gaskets and shredded tires. Nothing useful remains.
item.onCollect: You sift through the rubber debris and salvage a high-grade Rubber Piece!

crevice_magnifying_glass.description: A narrow fissure in a pile of compressed engines. Something brass and glass glints deep inside.

item.name: Magnifying Glass
item.description: A thick glass lens with a brass handle. It makes small things look large, or can focus light into a burning point.
item.onCollect: You reach into the tight crevice and pull out Willy's lost Magnifying Glass! It's dirty but intact!

scrap_magnet.description: A massive industrial electromagnet hanging from a rusted crane structure. The control panel is dead and filled with cut wires. Interacting with it might let a Master Tinkerer rewire it!

compact_crusher.description: A slow-moving piston that periodically crushes heaps of junk.

broken_boiler.description: An old steam boiler that has cold ash spilling out of its furnace.

exit_east.description: A heavy metal security gate that creaks open just enough to pass.

conditions.failMessage: The eastern gate is magnetically sealed! You need Willy's Magnifying Glass — check the glinting crevice in the northwest corner of the scrapyard!
